name: zmodel_material_compare_for_reuse
description: zModel_Material::CompareForReuse compares reusable material fields, ignores cycle data, and promotes a nonzero user tag into a matching zero-tag peer.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this material comparison helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel material/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x480d20 validates the currentTextureDirectoryEntry quick reject, 32-byte prefix comparison through rep cmpsb, nonzero signed byte-compare result on mismatch, zero return for equal userTag, in-place userTag promotion when exactly one side is zero, and nonzero return for conflicting nonzero tags.
The native smoke verifies left and right userTag promotion, conflicting tags, texture mismatch, byte-field mismatch, and the FindOrClone reuse paths that depend on this comparison contract.
